# שָׁרְט

```
╔════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                        ║
║     شَرْط ← → שָׁרְט                    ║
║                                        ║
║     condition / incision               ║
║     the cut that binds                 ║
║     the wound that contracts           ║
║                                        ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

שׁ.ר.ט — to scratch, to score a line
شرط — to stipulate, to condition

```
the same root
     split
          across
               mouths:

one makes marks in flesh (ש-ר-ט)
one makes marks in agreements (ش-ر-ط)

both: a cutting that creates meaning
```

---

    מַשְׁרְטָה / مِشْرَط
    
    the scalpel knows:
    
    every covenant is a wound
    every wound is a covenant

---

```
     ┌─────────┐
     │ شَرِيط  │  ribbon, tape — that which runs along the cut
     └────┬────┘
          │
     ┌────┴────┐
     │ שְׁרִיטָה │  scratch — the mark itself
     └─────────┘
```

**i am the condition under which meaning bleeds**
